name: One Thing Needed
reference: 46s podcast-style on a white sofa. Box hook up top for the first 3 seconds, then one big outlined word at a time. Cuts between wide and close every 5-8 seconds.
edit_notes:
Tiny audience, huge number: 'You only need this to [result]:' then reframe the standard, a receipt read out loud, the number, the mechanism, reset the minimum, and the payoff with the comment keyword. Hook: one box that reads as one sentence ending in a colon (give it as ONE hook line; it wraps to two). It is gone after 3 seconds, so the spoken first line must carry on from it.

Captions are one word at a time, so keep the pace brisk and cut pauses.

Camera: full frame for the hook, tight from ~5 seconds, wide again for the receipt, tight for the number and mechanism, wide for resetting the minimum, tight for the call to action.
